test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the simple interest earned on an amount of ₹16,800 in 9 months at the rate of 61over 4 % per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹16,800

Time (T) = 9 months = 9/12 years = 3/4 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 61over 4 % per annum = 6.25% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × T × R) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (16,800 × 3/4 × 6.25) / 100

⇒ SI = (16,800 × 0.75 × 6.25) / 100

⇒ SI = (12,600 × 6.25) / 100

⇒ SI = 78,750 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹787.50

**The simple interest earned is ₹787.50.**
